question: Magkano ang taunang mechanical inspection fee para sa centralized aircon at window type air conditioner?
answer: The annual mechanical inspection fee for a centralized air conditioning system varies depending on the tonnage. For up to 100 tons, it is 90.00 PHP per ton [S2]. For every ton or fraction thereof above 100 tons, it is 40.00 PHP per ton [S2]. For window type air conditioners, the fee is 60.00 PHP per unit [S2]. No information was found for the mechanical inspection fee for window type air conditioners with a tonnage below 100 tons. For more specific information, please refer to the source document "CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf" on pages 513 and 583, specifically the chunks DEV120-OCBO-PDF0025-C002 and DEV120-OCBO-PDF0095-C002.
